question: Which of the following is India's fastest supercomputer as of December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PARAM Siddhi-AI**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PARAM Siddhi-AI **__is India's fastest supercomputer as of December 2020.
 
• A supercomputer is a computer with a high level of performance as compared to a general-purpose computer.
 
• They have been used for scientific and engineering applications that require the handling of very large databases and require a great amount of computation.
 
• Supercomputers perform multiple parallel processing.
 
• **PARAM Siddhi-AI**
 __
 
• It is developed jointly with the support of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) under NSM.
 
• It is the high-performance computing-artificial intelligence (HPC-AI) supercomputer established under National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) at C-DAC.
 
• It will help testing of weather forecasting packages by NCMRWF & IITM, geo exploration packages for oil and gas recovery; packages for aero design studies; computational physics and mathematical applications and even online courses for HRD.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **“Pratyush” **is a Cray-XC40 LC [Liquid Cooled] System with a peak performance of 4,006 TFLOPS and a total system memory of 414TB. It is used in the fields of weather forecasting and climate monitoring in India.
 
• **SAGA-220 **is a supercomputer built by the Indian Space Research Organisation. It is being used by space scientists for solving complex aerospace problems.
 
• **MIHIR"** is a Cray-XC40 LC [Liquid Cooled] System with a peak performance of 2,806 TFLOPS and a total system memory of 290TB. It is used in the fields of weather forecasting and climate monitoring in India.
